founding: In the spring of the first year, {abbot} and {brothers} brothers came to the ruin at {place}. They cleared the rubble from the old chapel, sang Vespers under a broken roof, and dedicated the house to {patron}.

In the spring of the first year, {abbot} led {brothers} brothers up the road to {place}, where a chapel of the old world still stood without its windows. There they founded the house of {patron}, with three sacks of seed and one goat.
death_age: {When}, {monk} died in his sleep at {age_words} years of age, and was buried beside the chapel.
{When}, {monk}, {age_words} years old, asked for the sacraments after Compline and was dead before Lauds. The brothers said he had been ready for some time.
{When}, {monk} went to God in the fullness of his years. He was {age_words}, and had outlived the world he was born in.
death_illness: {When}, {monk} did not recover from his sickness. He was buried in the brothers' field, facing east.
{When}, the fever took {monk}. The healers did what they could, and the brothers kept vigil until the end.
{When}, {monk} died of a sickness of the chest after many weeks in the infirmary.
election_after_death: After the burial of {old}, the brothers met in chapter and chose Brother {new_name} as their abbot.
When the bell had been tolled for {old}, the brothers elected Brother {new_name} to lead the house. He wept, and did not refuse.
election_after_departure: With {old} gone from the house, the brothers met in chapter and chose Brother {new_name} as their abbot.
Since {old} was no longer among them, the brothers elected Brother {new_name} in his place.
hunger: {When}, the granary ran empty and hunger came to the house. The brothers ate nettle soup and kept the Office all the same.
{When}, there was no bread. The brothers fasted though it was no fast day, and some grew weak.
cold: {When}, the woodpile was gone and the cold came into the dormitory. The old brothers suffered most.
{When}, there was nothing left to burn, and the brothers slept in the chapel together for the warmth.
harvest_good: The harvest of the {year_ordinal} year was good. The granary was full by Michaelmas, and the abbot ordered a Te Deum.
In the {year_ordinal} year the fields gave generously, and the house went into winter without fear.
harvest_fair: The harvest of the {year_ordinal} year was neither good nor bad, and the brothers gave thanks for it.
In the {year_ordinal} year the harvest was enough, if the winter was not long.
harvest_poor: The harvest of the {year_ordinal} year was poor, and the brothers looked at the granary and said nothing.
In the {year_ordinal} year the fields failed them. The abbot ordered the rations cut before the first frost.
winter_begins: Winter came early to {place} that year, and the stream froze before Advent.
The first snow fell on the chapel roof, and the brothers moved the scriptorium desks closer to the fire.
return_generic: {monk} came home from the road with little to tell.
{monk} returned to the house, footsore, and went straight to the chapel.
house_fell: Here the annals of the house of {patron} at {place} end. No brother remained to keep them.
And the house of {patron} fell silent. The wind came in through the chapel windows as it had before the brothers came.
